label: Giving by an owned rational power at a world
definition: RationallyGivesAt F A w g x: some power p belongs to g, is rational, and g's giving x being at some moment in w exercises p. This combines PowerOf, Rational and GivesBy from the existing agency overlay.
note: Analyst reconstruction. Illustrative analogue: a builder actually builds by exercising her rational inclination to build. A builder who also radiates body heat illustrates an effect for which the possessed will supplies no exercise. Applying the distinction to universal esse-giving remains open. No transitivity, uniqueness of power, or modal variation is built in. Rational classifies a power; the definition records its exercise for this effect without encoding what was understood or how that content determined the exercise. See docs/notes/divine-love-goodness-bridge.md.
